answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a tundra bet on surviving 69 epochs of grading, and every knoll settlement recomputes the whisper schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 69 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
